ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Remote Logon with Explicit Credentials
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious processes logging on with explicit credentials Note: Unmapped fields: ProcessName, TargetServerName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4648 AND (ProcessName = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\winrs\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT (TargetServerName = "localhost" OR (user = RGX("\\$$") AND dest_user = RGX("\\$$")))
